events.summary: 塔拉辛在起居室的胡桃木书桌前起草《刑事责任措施》的替代方案，凯德质疑此举是否有必要。
events.quote: Khaede loomed on the other side of the walnut-wood escritoire in the solar, her elbows perched atop its shelves as she looked down her nose at Talasyn outlining a counterproposal to the criminal liability measure.

events.summary: 塔拉辛对凯德说，内纳瓦雷人教过她写政策，且国王陛下要求在她明日上会前先审阅这份方案。
events.quote: “The Nenavarene taught me how to write policy,” she said, addressing Khaede’s remark.

events.summary: 凯德告知塔拉辛：她已联系上级，奥尔福尔德对加赫里斯·奥西纳斯在玛哈吉尔安息岛建基地一事毫无情报。
events.quote: “I’ll check if the servants have any clue,” said Khaede. “Also, Tal—I contacted my superiors after you mentioned that Gaheris Ossinast built a base on Mahagir’s Rest.

events.summary: 塔拉辛据新基地的隐秘性与建成时间推断，虚空源可能就在玛哈吉尔安息岛上。
events.quote: A new military base in a remote location, kept confidential, built after the war . . . “The Voidfell source could be on Mahagir’s Rest.”

events.summary: 塔拉辛向凯德坦白自己的以太术已消失，她不再是大陆最后一位光织者。
events.quote: “My aethermancy is gone.” It hurt to say it. It would never not hurt. Talasyn had been the Continent’s last Lightweaver.

events.summary: 凯德为一开始就怀疑塔拉辛道歉，并称自己会永远是她的朋友。
events.quote: While I’m not at liberty to give you all the details yet, for what it’s worth—” Khaede cleared her throat. “I am sorry. For being suspicious of you right away.”

events.summary: 阿拉里克夜里在塔拉辛房中审阅她的方案，承认若在相识前他会毫不犹豫批准该措施。
events.quote: “Before we met, I probably wouldn’t have,” he admitted. “I’d have signed off on it without a second thought.

events.summary: 阿拉里克邀请塔拉辛出席邻城次日下午的节庆，作为她以夜之女皇身份的首次公开露面。
events.quote: “Your first public appearance as the Night Empress,” said Alaric. “We’ve put that off long enough.

relations.relation: 主仆兼同盟：凯德被指派为塔拉辛的侍女，同时受奥尔福尔德之命试探其忠诚
relations.quote: “Once I was designated your lady’s maid, my first objective was to gauge whether you really were still loyal to the Sardovian Allfold,”

relations.relation: 夫妻：塔拉辛正谋划背叛丈夫，阿拉里克却信任她
relations.quote: But Talasyn had to distract herself from her impending betrayal of her husband.

relations.relation: 朋友：二人和解，塔拉辛感到凯德真正回到了她身边
relations.quote: she felt, for the first time, that Khaede had truly come back to her.

relations.relation: 上下级：凯德向奥尔福尔德上级汇报并请示
relations.quote: “Also, Tal—I contacted my superiors after you mentioned that Gaheris Ossinast built a base on Mahagir’s Rest.

relations.relation: 政治联姻背景：凯萨思与内纳瓦的联盟是这段婚姻的现实基础
relations.quote: it was all too easy to trace his possessiveness and protectiveness back to his lonesome childhood and the political necessity of the alliance between Kesath and Nenavar.

numbers.context: 塔拉辛与凯德每天只上阳台密谈一次，以免暴露
numbers.quote: They limited their forays here to once per day because it was better to be safe than sorry.

numbers.context: 凯德强调摧毁虚空源只有一次机会
numbers.quote: “We’ll only get one shot at this. You need to confirm it.”

numbers.context: 塔拉辛在过去一年里学会了把心里话讲出来
numbers.quote: But Talasyn had learned over the past year that there were occasions wherein the heaviness in one’s heart could only be diminished by giving words wings.

numbers.context: 塔拉辛与凯德并肩背靠栏杆而立
numbers.quote: After a while, Khaede turned with her, the two of them with their backs to the railing, standing side by side and almost close enough to touch.

numbers.context: 节庆定在次日下午，议会结束后前往邻城
numbers.quote: “We have been invited to a festival tomorrow afternoon,” he told the blanket draped over his lap.
